newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti Q1 pre-tax loss 180 billion lire.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti Q1 pre-tax loss 180 billion lire.

text.p: Italy's Olivetti on Tuesday said that it estimated its group loss before tax and before Omnitel in the first quarter of 1997 at 180 billion lire, which was in line with the group's budget.

A group statement said its Q1 sales slipped 10.4 percent to 1.378 trillion lire, but this excluded revenues of 172 billion lire from Olivetti Personal Computers which was sold at the beginning of April.

The group confirmed that it expected to approach break-even in 1997 before taxes and its pro-quota loss at Omnitel, and this included the possible sale of non-strategic equity investments and disposal of loss-making operations and the effect of the entry of important new strategic partners such as France Telecom into its Infostrada joint venture.

It added that the group's total net financial requirement at the end of the first quarter, which still included the entire financial requirement of the Personal Computer's operations, before the sale of trade receivables and including receipts and payments up to April 1 was around 2.700 trillion lire compared to 2.197 trillion lire at end-1996.
